expansion: Organic, without poison: garden with heart
tagline: Vegetables, fruit and healthy soil in the organic garden: gardening without poison, with patience and joy
description: BYOY is a guide for organic kitchen gardens in Germany: create vegetable patches and raised beds, build compost and healthy soil, plan mixed crops and crop rotation, care for fruit trees and berry bushes, promote beneficial insects and collect seeds yourself, without any chemical plant protection.
author: BYOY editorial team

gemuesegarten.name: vegetable garden
gemuesegarten.description: Create beds and raised beds, potatoes, tomatoes, zucchini, beans, onions and garlic: grow vegetables organically outdoors.

kompost-und-boden.name: Compost & Soil
kompost-und-boden.description: Creating compost and using it correctly, recognizing soil type, mulching, green manure and organic fertilizing: the basis of every organic garden.

mischkultur-und-fruchtfolge.name: Mixed culture & crop rotation
mischkultur-und-fruchtfolge.description: Good and bad neighbors, heavy and weak feeders, cultivation plan, pre- and post-culture: plan beds wisely so that the soil stays healthy.

obst-und-beeren.name: Fruit & Berries
obst-und-beeren.description: Planting and cutting fruit trees, suitable varieties for small gardens, currants, raspberries, strawberries and blueberries in the garden.

naturgarten-und-nuetzlinge.name: Natural garden & beneficial insects
naturgarten-und-nuetzlinge.description: Promote beneficial insects, deal with snails and fungal diseases without poison, wild bees, hedgehogs, flowering meadows, dead wood hedges and dry stone walls.

saatgut-und-jungpflanzen.name: Seeds & young plants
saatgut-und-jungpflanzen.description: Understand and obtain hardened seeds yourself, harden off and plant germination samples, direct sowing, cold frames and young plants safely.

promo.label: ✦ From the bed to the net
